# gramlot 0.3.10 — Runtime and security corrections

Repairs the first confirmed correction tranche from the review of 0.3.9:

- Drawer labels retain formatted HTML, sanitized with the existing tree-caption policy.
- Python and JavaScript renderers reject executable `javascript:` form actions and script text or URLs supplied through Data. Literal scripts received with Source remain supported; the live runtime refuses later replacement code.
- Hosted input components share the runtime Bag identity for stores and validation results.
- Attribute expressions acquire their binding lifetime before default installation.
- Removing a remote declaration cancels its timers and delayed calls and suppresses its completion hook. An in-flight fragment retains the existing node-request contract.
- SVG nodes publish through the root builder.
- Python page modules register before execution, support dataclasses, annotation resolution and pickle, restore registration after failed reloads and release registrations on shutdown.

Regression checks cover these behaviors in source, built bundles and browser execution.

## Distribution

The core is published on PyPI as `gramlot` and npm as `@gramlot/gramlot`. The Python package contains the updated browser runtime and component assets. JSR publication is suspended. This release does not require new releases of `gramlot-js-server` or `gramlot-serverless`; those projects retain their existing versions.

## Known limitations

This is a bounded correction release, not completion of the entire audit. Additional embedding/SVG security surfaces and parent-frame trust policy still need separate assessment; attribute-name validation in string rendering belongs to Builders. Remaining work includes transport/file-picker error handling, null/readonly edge cases, editor efficiency, API/type/documentation alignment, packaging size and duplication. The optional Typst collection still carries its existing large browser payload; packaging separation is deferred.

Database/legacy experiments and unrelated local developments are excluded. Gramlot Catalog and the requested dialog, floating, labelgroup and copy-button follow-up are future work, not features of this release.
